extraction: Anthropic multi-agent patterns: (1) Prompt chaining — decompose task into sequential prompts. (2) Routing — classify input, dispatch to specialist. (3) Parallelization — run independent subtasks concurrently. (4) Orchestrator-worker — central orchestrator manages workers. (5) Evaluator-optimizer — generator produces, evaluator critiques, iterate. Our 3-agent model = Orchestrator-worker (me→Engine/Verdict/Miss) + Evaluator-optimizer (Verdict→Miss fix-loop) + Parallelization (staggered engines). Prompt chaining = Engine build steps.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether Anthropic patterns validate our 3-agent composition as best-practice
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
